column.name: description
column.value: Id of the organization record that is this laboratory. Set by the system.

changeSet.author: mozzy11
changeSet.comment: Record the existing facility organization (short name FACILITY_ORG) of an upgraded installation.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE clinlims.site_information SET value = (SELECT CAST(MIN(o.id) AS VARCHAR) FROM clinlims.organization o WHERE o.short_name = 'FACILITY_ORG'), lastupdated = now() WHERE name = 'facilityOrganizationId' AND (value IS NULL OR value = '') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.organization o WHERE o.short_name = 'FACILITY_ORG');
